classes.name: Lwm2mObserveAttrTelemetryComponent

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from valueChanges subscription on component destruction.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.
